errors.text_span: като всяка година е представена с групирани стълбове, които са натрупани едно върху друго
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that each year is represented by grouped bars that are stacked. The chart actually shows two main sections ('Внос' and 'Износ'), and within each section, there is a single stacked bar for each year. The bars are not grouped by year.

errors.text_span: като тяхното разположение е в азбучен ред
errors.evidence: The description claims the years on the horizontal axis are in alphabetical order. They are in chronological order (2004, 2005, 2006, etc.).

errors.text_span: като всяка година има два съответстващи стълба
errors.evidence: This phrasing implies that for each year, there are two bars (import and export) placed side-by-side, which is the structure of a standard grouped bar chart. However, this chart's layout consists of two separate sections of bars, one for all import years and one for all export years.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени по азбучен ред по хоризонталната ос
errors.evidence: This is a repetition of the earlier error. The bars, which represent years, are ordered chronologically on the horizontal axis, not alphabetically.
